caption: The drawing depicts a single object, an iron trivet, shown from three different perspectives on a plain, light-colored background. The main portion of the trivet has an elongated, leaf-like shape with an intricate, symmetrical openwork pattern inside, consisting of a series of radiating, curved lines and spirals. The handle is oval and solid, extending from the narrow end of the trivet. Two small legs support the base. The trivet is rendered in gray tones, indicating a metallic, iron-like texture. At the top of the image, there is a flat, top-down view of the trivet, and beneath it, a side profile showing its thickness and the length of the supporting legs. At the lower right, there is a three-quarter perspective illustrating its three-dimensional form. There is a small scale underneath the side profile, and a name, “Julius Bellamy,” appears in small letters at the bottom right corner.
title: Flat Iron Holder
